claims.label: Romney–Netanyahu Friendship Dated to 1976 at Boston Consulting Group
claims.claim: Per the 2012 New York Times article the host shows, a friendship between Mitt Romney and Benjamin Netanyahu dates to 1976; the host says they both worked at the Boston Consulting Group then.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the NYT 2012 article in full and verify the 1976 Boston Consulting Group employment dates against public records.

claims.label: Kash Patel Declared Subject in Custody ~4 Hours After Shooting
claims.claim: Per the X post the host shows, Kash Patel wrote that the subject for the shooting that took the life of Charlie Kirk was now in custody; the host says he posted it at 4:21 p.m. Mountain time, almost exactly four hours after Charlie was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the tweet's exact timestamp and confirm the subject's identity against law enforcement records.

claims.label: Same Subject Released After Interrogation ~90 Minutes Later
claims.claim: Per the X post the host shows, Kash Patel wrote that the subject in custody had been released after an interrogation by law enforcement; the host says he posted it at 5:59 PM the same day and that no further explanation was given.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain law enforcement records documenting the detention, interrogation, and release; cross-reference with identity of "Zachariah Qureshi."

claims.label: Detained Subject Identified as Zachariah Qureshi
claims.claim: The young man detained and released after interrogation is referred to as "Zachariah Qureshi," with the host later connecting him to Ahmed Qureshi's son "Zachariah."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm spelling of "Qureshi" vs. "Qureshi" against official detention records; the name discrepancy requires resolution.

claims.label: Host Says Ahmed Qureshi Is Active-Duty Navy Captain (O6)
claims.claim: Per Ahmed Qureshi's LinkedIn profile, which the host shows, he is President/COO of BILT Incorporated and an O6 commanding officer (Navy Captain) at East Coast HQ since May 2024, according to the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current rank and command assignment via official military biography.

claims.label: Host Says Ahmed Qureshi and Nathan Henderson Co-Founded BILT Incorporated
claims.claim: The host says BILT Incorporated was co-founded by Ahmed Qureshi (an O5 at the time) and Nathan Henderson in 2015.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check corporate registration records (Secretary of State filings in Texas) for BILT Incorporated founders and incorporation date.

claims.label: Host Says USA Spending Shows BILT Inc. Received ~$7.4M Air Force + Under $250K Navy in June 2025
claims.claim: The host says USA Spending records show BILT Incorporated received approximately $7.4M from the Air Force and just under a quarter million from the Navy in June 2025, with the largest contracts dated June 1 and June 16, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the raw USA Spending entries for Built Inc. by UEI, confirm contract amounts and dates against Baron Coleman's timeline.

claims.label: Host Shows LinkedIn Listing Gina Romney Henderson as VP UX at BILT Inc.
claims.claim: Per Gina Romney Henderson's LinkedIn profile, which the host shows, she is Vice President of User Experience at BILT Incorporated.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm employment and BYU degree via LinkedIn and university alumni records; investigate "Romney" family-tie claim.

claims.label: Host Says Connor Henderson Worked as ER Scribe at Timpanogos
claims.claim: The host says Connor Henderson worked as an emergency room scribe at Timpanogos Hospital from 2024 until approximately the time of Charlie Kirk's assassination, if his LinkedIn is to be believed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Connor Henderson's actual LinkedIn profile; verify Timpanogos HR records of scribe employment.

claims.label: FBI Abandoned Comparative Bullet Lead Analysis in 2005
claims.claim: Per the 2007 Washington Post article the host shows, the FBI abandoned comparative bullet lead analysis in 2005, a year after a 2004 National Academy of Sciences report found FBI testimony about the technique unreliable and potentially misleading.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the 2004 NAS report and 2007 WaPo article in full; verify FBI's formal abandonment date.

claims.label: Host Says the FBI Is Reviving CBLA in the Robinson Case
claims.claim: The host says the FBI is bringing the previously abandoned comparative bullet lead analysis technique back into use in a bid to connect Tyler Robinson's weapon to the alleged bullet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court filings and ATF lab reports in the Robinson case to confirm whether CBLA is being used or referenced.

claims.label: Trump Told Erika Kirk at Easter to Sue Critics
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from an Easter event, Donald Trump says he told Erika Kirk she has to sue people because they are so jealous of her; the host says he told her to sue people making fun of her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited video of the Easter remarks; document any subsequent legal actions filed by Kirk.

claims.label: Qureshi and Henderson Families Lived in Same House, Keller, Texas
claims.claim: The host says the Qureshi and Henderson families lived in the same house in Keller, Texas; she offers alternative explanations (vacation rental, sale) but asserts cohabitation is not in dispute.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull property records for Keller, Texas to identify ownership/residency history of both families.

claims.label: Host Says Andrew Zenger Was Appointed CEO of Timpanogos on 2025-08-19
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Zenger was appointed CEO of Timpanogos Hospital on August 19, 2025, weeks before the September 10 event.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Timpanogos press releases, LinkedIn, or Utah business filings.

claims.label: Host Says Andrew Zenger Was Previously COO at Medical City, McKinney, Texas
claims.claim: The host says that prior to Timpanogos, Andrew Zenger served as COO of Medical City in McKinney, Texas.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Medical City Healthcare press releases or LinkedIn employment history.

claims.label: Andrew Zenger Attended BYU Jerusalem
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Zenger attended BYU Jerusalem and was there during the Mitt Romney presidential election season.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via BYU Jerusalem Center enrollment records or alumni directory.

claims.label: BYU Jerusalem Is a CIA Recruitment Site for Elite Mormon Youth
claims.claim: The host says an unnamed person told her the BYU Jerusalem Center is where elite Mormon youth are approached by their teachers to work for the CIA; she adds that the program director is Israeli and says she knows this for a fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corroborating documentation; on-screen artifact required to elevate from claim to inscribed record.

claims.label: Metro One Talent Is the CIA's Recruiting Vendor
claims.claim: The host says the CIA uses a company called Metro One Talent to interview and bring on board young recruits such as those from BYU Jerusalem.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify Metro One Talent corporate records and any government contract listings.

claims.label: Host Says Michael Shawn Covey (Zenger's Jerusalem Roommate) Does CIA Contract Work
claims.claim: The host says Michael Shawn Covey, a roommate of Andrew Zenger from the Jerusalem period, contracts with the CIA.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any government contract records for "Michael Shawn Covey."

claims.label: Host Says Robbie Hild Attended BYU, Played Lacrosse, Graduated ~2020
claims.claim: The host says Robbie Hild attended BYU, played lacrosse, and appears to have graduated around 2020.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via BYU athletics records and class roster.

claims.label: Turning Point Sent Fundraising Texts Within 48 Hours of Death
claims.claim: The host says someone sent her Turning Point USA fundraising text messages, sent about 48 hours after Charlie Kirk's death, that began "Hi, I'm Erika and for Charlie's legacy, please give".
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copies of the original SMS messages and the timestamp metadata.

claims.label: Viewer Comment Host Reads Says Turning Point Sent Funeral-Image Fundraising Mailer
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads (from Yoshi) says Turning Point sent a direct mail fundraising plea using a photo of Erika Kirk walking out on stage in her sparkle suit to a show of fireworks; the host says she heard such mailers were sent and that the image is from the funeral, she thinks.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual mailer from recipients; verify whether the image is from the funeral or another event.

claims.label: Robbie Hild Family Allegedly Married Into Romney Family
claims.claim: The host says she learned from viewers that Robbie Hild's family is allegedly married into the Romney family and that across social media they were involved in the campaign, but she cannot find the document establishing the connection and requests viewer tips.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via marriage records, family genealogical databases, or corroborating viewer emails with documentation.

claims.label: Host Says Caleb Cunningham Was in Jerusalem During 2012 Romney Campaign
claims.claim: The host says Caleb Cunningham was in Jerusalem with Andrew Zenger during the Mitt Romney presidential election season and was an activist who worked for the campaign.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Romney 2012 campaign staff lists and BYU Jerusalem Center enrollment.

claims.label: Host Says Jeffrey Knuckles Was in Jerusalem and Later Romney Campaign Advisor
claims.claim: The host says Jeffrey Knuckles was in Jerusalem with Andrew Zenger during the Mitt Romney presidential election season and later served as an advisor to Romney's campaign.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Romney 2012 campaign staff biographies.

claims.label: BYU Recruits CIA Talent From Hawaii and Jerusalem Campuses
claims.claim: The host says the CIA plucks students from BYU's Hawaii campus in particular and approaches students at BYU Jerusalem about working for the CIA, while saying she is not saying everyone who goes to BYU is in the CIA.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any open-source reporting on BYU recruitment ties.

claims.label: Viewer Comment Read by the Host Says a 2009 BYU Study Found Thermite in WTC Dust
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads says BYU physicist Dr. Steven Jones published a 2009 study proving advanced thermite-based explosives in the dust from ground zero.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the actual 2009 paper and verify the journal of publication and peer review status.

claims.label: Viewer Suggests Robinson Defense Release 600,000 Documents
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads (Kael Miles) says the 600,000 documents should be made public for viewers to sort through; the host calls it great advice for Robinson's defense and offers to serve as an unpaid document-review army.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the document set being referenced and any pending defense motions for discovery.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Tweets Vetted by Lawyers and PR Agents Never Addressed the Netanyahu Call
claims.claim: The host says the long tweets TPUSA put out explaining that it did nothing wrong were overseen by lawyers and PR agents, and that none of them addressed Charlie Kirk's final call with Benjamin Netanyahu.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect TPUSA's public statements since 2025-09-10 and check whether any mentions the Netanyahu call; ask TPUSA whether lawyers or a PR firm reviewed them.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tweets that were overseen by lawyers and PR agents. No one wanted to address BB Netanyahu's call.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie's Final Call With Netanyahu Took Place in the Hamptons
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's final phone call with Benjamin Netanyahu was the one that took place in the Hamptons.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish whether the Hamptons gathering and the Netanyahu call were one event or two (host elsewhere calls the Hamptons event a summit or meeting); obtain attendee accounts and Kirk's phone records.
claims.transcript_snippet: is that final phone call that Charlie had with BB Netanyahu. The one that took place in the Hamptons

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Described the Netanyahu Call as an Intervention Over Israel
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk described his final call with Netanyahu as an intervention over the topic of Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who Kirk described the call to and obtain their account; compare with Hamptons attendees' accounts and Kirk's messages from August 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie described it, as I told you, as an intervention over the topic of Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu Offered to Take Turning Point to the Next Level
claims.claim: The host says Netanyahu offered to take Turning Point USA 'to the next level' and that she does not know what he asked for in exchange.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the source of the offer (host elsewhere names Andrew Kolvet) and any TPUSA or Israeli government records of a funding proposal.
claims.transcript_snippet: BB offered, as I said, to take Turning Point to the next level, and what troubles me is not knowing the answer in exchange for what?

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point Already Brings In $100 Million Per Year
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is already pulling in $100 million per year.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA's IRS Form 990 filings and annual reports for total annual revenue.
claims.transcript_snippet: an organization that is already pulling in $100 million per year to the next level?

claims.label: Host Says Charlie and Netanyahu Were Butting Heads Over War in Iran
claims.claim: The host says war in Iran was the particular issue on which Netanyahu and Charlie Kirk were butting heads.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect Kirk's June 2025 public and private statements on Iran and Netanyahu's contacts with him.
claims.transcript_snippet: War in Iran, particularly the issue that BB and Charlie were butting heads about.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Is Recasting Charlie's Legacy as Pro-War in the Middle East
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is trying to twist and reimagine Charlie Kirk's legacy as pro-war in the Middle East and the war in Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA statements and events since September 2025 on Iran and Israel with Kirk's recorded positions before his death.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA is trying to twist and reimagine his legacy as pro-war in the Middle East, war in Iran, and BB is doing the most

claims.label: Host Says the Egyptian Planes Revealed a Connection Between Israel and Utah
claims.claim: The host says that when she began probing the Egyptian planes narrative she was shown a clear connection between Israel and Utah.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the flight-tracking records for the Egyptian-registered aircraft and the host's spreadsheet to see which legs touch Israel and Provo.
claims.transcript_snippet: as I began prodding the narrative of the Egyptian planes, it was revealed to me that there clearly is a connection to Israel and Utah

claims.label: Host Says There Are No Eyewitnesses From Inside Timpanogos Hospital on September 10
claims.claim: The host says it is increasingly strange that there are no eyewitnesses from inside the hospital regarding September 10, even though Turning Point staff went to the ER lobby and an ER normally has people in it.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek accounts from Timpanogos ER patients, visitors and staff present on 2025-09-10 and the hospital's visitor and admission logs.

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel Had the FBI Seize Hospital Footage on Arrival
claims.claim: The host says that when Kash Patel arrived, he had the FBI immediately seize the footage from inside the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI evidence receipt or legal process for the hospital footage and Patel's travel record for 2025-09-10.
claims.transcript_snippet: when Kash Patel arrived, he had the FBI immediately seize the footage from inside the hospital.

claims.label: Host Says Elizabeth Lane Was on the Ground at Utah Valley Hospital and Sent a Colleague to Timpanogos
claims.claim: The host says journalist Elizabeth Lane was on the ground on September 10, went to Utah Valley hospital and sent a colleague to Timpanogos, and posted about it at length on X.
claims.investigative_direction: Read Lane's X post and ask her which hospital staff and officers she observed and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: she was actually a journalist that was on the ground that day. She went to Utah Valley hospital, and she sent her colleague over to Timpanogos

claims.label: Host Says Both Hospitals Were Locked Down
claims.claim: The host says Lane remarked on how odd it was that both Utah Valley and Timpanogos hospitals had been locked down, something the host says she had raised earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain lockdown orders, hospital security logs and Orem and Provo police dispatch records for 2025-09-10.
claims.transcript_snippet: how odd it was that they had locked down both hospitals, something that I brought up to you, right? They locked down both hospitals.

claims.claim: The host says Elizabeth Lane has been positing that Erika Kirk is a psychopath.

claims.transcript_snippet: Elizabeth Lane, that's the one who has been positing that Erika Kirk is a psychopath.
